list_forms.title: List forms
list_forms.description: List every form the API key's user has created, each with its id, public_id, name, field definitions (body), options and timestamps. Use it to find a form id; use get_form for one form and list_form_responses for its submissions.

get_form.title: Get a form
get_form.description: Get one form by its numeric id: name, public_id, the field definitions in body (component, type, label, id, required, page), and options such as visibility, max_submissions, thank-you message and redirect URL. Use list_form_responses to read what people submitted.

list_form_responses.title: List form responses
list_form_responses.description: List the submissions to one form, each with its response map of field id to value, options.ip and created_at. Cursor-paginated: pass cursor.after or cursor.before from the previous page. Filter with `query` and sort with `order`.

limit.description: How many responses to return per page.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's cursor.after, to fetch the next page.

before.description: Cursor from the previous page's cursor.before, to fetch the previous page.

output.description: count, cursor {after, before} and data: the FormResponseItem list (id, form_id, response, options, created_at, updated_at).
